experiment: P5 pooled binary logistic ranker walk-forward
dataset: adaptive_novelty_feature_matrix.npz from q90_bundle; 3348 target dates 2017-09-05 to 2026-11-04
target: For each target draw, label the largest of the five actual VinciCasa numbers (P5), among candidates 1..40.
method: Pooled binary LogisticRegression(C=0.05, max_iter=300), StandardScaler, fit on prior-period draw-number rows (40 candidates per draw), rank all 40 candidate probabilities per test draw. No test labels used in fit.
interpretation: Strong preliminary ranking signal in this temporal holdout, materially above the 12.5% uniform-rank top-5 baseline. This is not yet a validated 80% threshold, and not evidence of 80% draw prediction. The observed gap may be driven by label/feature construction, P5 number distribution, or a hidden temporal dependency. Must audit feature semantics and test on strict rolling origins, additional cutoffs, and shuffled/negative controls before promoting to production.
next_checks: Audit the 59 feature definitions for target contamination and candidate number alignment
Repeat with strict rolling walk-forward retraining at multiple cutoffs
Permutation/null tests and label-shift negative controls
Compare calibrated model to feature rank_consensus_27 and recent_3; assess stability by year and number band
